grid-inch-zoom.autoApply.name: Auto apply on scene open
grid-inch-zoom.autoApply.hint: Align zoom so that each square is about 1" when the canvas is ready.
grid-inch-zoom.calibrationFactor.name: Calibration factor
grid-inch-zoom.calibrationFactor.hint: Multiplier to correct differences between 1 CSS inch and 1 real inch on your monitor (e.g., 1.02 = +2%).
grid-inch-zoom.targetInchesPerSquare.hin: Default is 1.0. You can choose 0.5" or 2" if you prefer smaller or larger squares.
